app/Main_OneActivationLatchesItOn: One activation latches it on, the next releases it.
app/Main_OneCSVFileThatTells: One CSV file that tells the QuadStick which sip, puff, lip press, or joystick move presses which game button. A profile has one or more mode sheets: full control layouts you switch between while playing (walking layout, driving layout, menus). Sip or puff the side tube, or bind increment_mode / decrement_mode, to switch modes in-game.
app/Main_OneShortPressEachTime: One short press each time you activate.
app/Main_OpenOrCreateAProfile: Open or create a profile first.
app/Main_OpenThisProfileSGoogle: Open this profile's Google Sheet in your browser
app/Main_OpenedFromYourQuadStickSave: Opened from your QuadStick. Save keeps a copy in your library; use Install to put changes back on the device.
app/Main_OpensAFreshCopyYou: Opens a fresh copy you can edit and install. Your template stays as it is.
app/Main_Original3HoleMouthpieceSide: Original: 3-hole mouthpiece, side tube, lip switch, rear jacks. Same inputs as the FPS.
app/Main_PathGetFileNamePathIsRemoved: {0} is removed from this computer for good. A copy on your QuadStick or in Google Sheets is not touched.
app/Main_PlugInTheQuadStickIt: Plug in the QuadStick; it shows up like a USB drive. Install backs up the old file to QuadStickBackups, writes a temp copy, checks it, then swaps it in. Errors block install. Overwriting default.csv always asks first.
app/Main_PrefsCsvHoldsTheQuadStick: prefs.csv holds the QuadStick's own settings, not a game profile. A wrong value here changes how the whole device behaves. Only continue if you know which setting you are changing.
app/Main_PrefsCsvIsTheQuadStick: prefs.csv is the QuadStick's own settings file, not a game profile: it changes how the whole device behaves, not just one game. A setting the app recognizes gets a real control, a number box, a checkbox, or a dropdown, so you cannot type a value the device would reject. A setting it does not recognize, or a value already in the file an exact control could not show without changing it, keeps a plain text box and is left exactly as it was. Installing prefs.csv back to the device always asks first, and backs up the file already there.
app/Main_PressAgainToOpenGoogle: Press again to open Google sign-in.
app/Main_PressTheLipSwitchOr: Press the lip switch or sensor with your lip. Often used for the fire button.
app/Main_PressesInARepeatingOn: Presses in a repeating on and off cycle.
app/Main_ProfilesYouAlreadyMadeFrom: Profiles you already made from this template are not affected. This cannot be undone.
app/Main_PuttingThisProfileInGoogle: Putting this profile in Google Sheets...
app/Main_RapidFireTapsWhileYour: Rapid-fire taps while your input is held.
app/Main_ReadThePrivacyPolicyOpens: Read the privacy policy, opens in your browser
app/Main_RecoveredProfileOpenedSaveIt: Recovered profile opened. Save it to keep it.
app/Main_RemoveThisEmptyInputFrom: Remove this empty input from mapping {0}
app/Main_RowsThatPressAGame: Rows that press a game button but have nothing triggering them yet. Give each one an input, or delete it.
app/Main_SaveThisProfileFirstThen: Save this profile first, then copy a share link to create its sheet.
app/Main_SavedTemplateFileNameFindIt: Saved template {0}. Find it under Use template on the home screen.
app/Main_SelectAProblemInThe: Select a problem in the list to copy it. File at github.com/Bbrizly/Quadstick-Config-Manager/issues. Say what you did and what went wrong.
app/Main_SelectATemplateToDelete: Select a template to delete first.
app/Main_SelectATemplateToRename: Select a template to rename first.
app/Main_SettingRowSpoken: Setting {0}: while this mode runs, set {1} to {2}. Press Enter to edit.
app/Main_SingletonASingleSipPuff: Singleton: a single sip/puff tube on the joystick. Uses sip and puff patterns plus joystick movement.
app/Main_SipOrPuffOnThe: Sip or puff on the left mouthpiece hole. A gentle sip or puff can do something different (the soft variants).
app/Main_SipOrPuffOnThe2: Sip or puff on the center mouthpiece hole. A gentle sip or puff can do something different (the soft variants).
app/Main_SipOrPuffOnThe3: Sip or puff on the right mouthpiece hole. A gentle sip or puff can do something different (the soft variants).
app/Main_SipOrPuffOnThe4: Sip or puff on the side tube. A long hard sip here normally switches profiles, but you can map it too.
app/Main_StartFromAWorkingProfile: Start from a working profile, not from scratch
app/Main_StartedFromTemplatePathGetFileN: Started from template {0}. Save to keep this as its own profile.
app/Main_StepsAnAnalogOutputDown: Steps an analog output down a notch and leaves it there, like a trigger or a stick axis.
app/Main_StepsAnAnalogOutputUp: Steps an analog output up a notch and leaves it there, like a trigger or a stick axis.
app/Main_TabMovesBetweenFieldsArrows: Tab moves between fields, arrows navigate suggestion lists, Enter confirms. Ctrl/Cmd+O open, S save, N new, Z undo, I install, D switch between Device view and List view, H this guide. F1 also opens this guide from anywhere. Selecting a problem, or the Fix first problem button, jumps focus straight to it. Every control announces itself to screen readers.
app/Main_ThatDoesNotLookLike: That does not look like a Google Sheets link. Paste the full link from your browser's address bar.
app/Main_ThatFolderIsAQuadStick: That folder is a QuadStick drive. Use Install to write to the device safely.
app/Main_ThatSpreadsheetCameBackEmpty: That spreadsheet came back empty. If you have just shared it, wait a moment and try again.
app/Main_ThatSpreadsheetHasNoProfile: That spreadsheet has no profile tab: cell A1 is empty. {0}
app/Main_ThatSpreadsheetHasNoProfile2: That spreadsheet has no profile tab: cell A1 says "{0}". {1}
app/Main_TheAppCrashedLastTime:
The app crashed last time. These are the crash details it saved. There is no message text and no file paths in here, on purpose: only the type of error and the list of functions it happened in.

Sending converts this into the crash reporter's own format. It also adds your anonymous install ID, the reporting library's version, your .NET and operating system versions, and whether your processor is Intel or ARM.
app/Main_TheCommunityProfilesCardOn: The Community profiles card on the home screen searches the shared list of game profiles. Opening that window, and pressing Refresh in it, downloads the list from quadstick.com. Nothing about you is sent, and the last list is kept on this computer so the window still opens with no internet. Import opens the profile in the editor, the same as pasting its link. It never writes to your QuadStick: that still takes the Install button, and errors still block it.
app/Main_TheDeviceSkipsThoseRows: . The device skips those rows, so this still installs.
app/Main_TheManageFilesCardUnder: The Manage files card, under On your QuadStick, works on a mounted QuadStick: its drive has to show up like a USB stick in Finder or File Explorer. From there you can copy a file to your library, open the Google Sheet it is linked to, or delete it; deleting backs it up to QuadStickBackups first. default.csv and prefs.csv are protected and cannot be deleted from this app. If the drive does not show up at all, this app has no other way to reach it; see QuadStick not showing up below.
app/Main_TheNameBoxAtThe: The name box at the top of the editor is the profile's on-device name. Use no spaces; the .csv file extension is added for you. The profile named default is special: it is the device's fallback file and should stay unchanged.
app/Main_TheOnlineCopyOfThis: The online copy of this profile is empty or unreadable, so your version on this computer was kept. Your next save replaces the sheet.
app/Main_TheThreeColumnsSameColors: The three columns (same colors as the official spreadsheets)
